column1: # Round aurora_v4_2026_10_29, job a (043-v4-a, GRID=this file, RID_PREFIX=a1029): recipe v3 seeds at 80 epochs.
# Same recipe as v3 (batch 16, prep_v4, ontology conditioning, operator injection, ++attention_query_chunk=512,
# registered window 0.875 = epochs 71-80, one cell per tile, fine-tune 1 = aurora_run_cell_043.sh chains the Kemmeren
# fine-tune from the epoch-80 last.pt). Reads that motivate it (2026-10-29): the v3 grid gave four seeds per arm at 80
# epochs with the lr lever inside the seed noise (Muenzner +0.012 at sd 0.014) and records weighting winning doubles
# (0.271) while losing Muenzner (0.230); GilaHyper gave 80 epochs over 50 at three seeds on Muenzner and Vaishnav only.
# Seeds 4-6 of the three v3 pinball-injection arms bring each to seven seeds; records weighting at lr 1.5e-4 (the one
# combination not yet run at 80 epochs) gets seeds 0-2.
